hypotheses.justification: Split on N.Nonempty, using the existing proof in the nonempty case. Otherwise N = ∅; choose n = 0 and the empty function z. Every everywhere-regular f lies in LSpace 0 by mem_lSpace_iff_ord and ord_nonneg_of_mem (including f = 0). IsCurveOver.exists_separating_transcendental supplies x and finite dimensionality over k⟮x⟯, so AlgebraicCurve.constantsAreBase_of_isAlgClosed_of_transcendental identifies LSpace 0 with the range of algebraMap k K. Thus f belongs to Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range z) by Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem. The generator-regularity condition is vacuous.
